title: CLAUDE.md – cfbplotR Development Guide
text: cfbplotR provides ggplot2 geoms, theme elements, scales, gt table helpers visualizing college-football logos, wordmarks, player headshots — CFB analogue nflplotR. built top ggpath package (nflplotR/nbaplotR pattern), handles image fetching, caching, colorizing, alpha-transparency rendering. Companion package: cfbfastR (Suggests) CFB data. Version: 0.1.0 (per DESCRIPTION) R Requirement: >= 4.1.0; ggplot2 (>= 4.0.0), ggpath (>= 1.1.0) (S7 theme elements) License: MIT Distribution: r-universe (sportsdataverse.r-universe.dev); CRAN badges README.Rmd commented (yet CRAN) Repository: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/cfbplotR Maintainer: Jared Lee (13jaredlee@gmail.com) Branch: main default release branch. Install development version:
code: # pak (recommended): pak::pkg_install("sportsdataverse/cfbplotR")  # or devtools: devtools::install_github("sportsdataverse/cfbplotR")

title: CLAUDE.md – cfbplotR Development Guide
text: cfbplotR sits thin domain layer top ggpath: ID resolution (R/utils.R): logo_from_school(), wordmark_from_school(), headshot_from_id() translate CFB team name ESPN player ID image URL path. Geoms (R/geom_cfb_logos.R, R/geom_cfb_wordmarks.R, R/geom_cfb_headshots.R): geom resolves team player_id aesthetic path via resolver helpers, delegates rendering ggpath::GeomFromPath$draw_panel(). Critical: ggpath::element_path S7 object – helper must construct via ggpath::element_path(alpha=..., colour=..., hjust=..., vjust=..., size=...). try structure() plain list re-class ; S7 property access break. Scales (R/scale_cfb.R): scale_color_cfb(), scale_fill_cfb(), scale_x_cfb(), scale_y_cfb() – map team names CFB primary/alt colors logo positions. gt helpers (R/gt_fmt_cfb.R, R/gt_stack_team.R): gt_fmt_cfb_logo(), gt_fmt_cfb_wordmark(), gt_fmt_cfb_headshot(), gt_cfb_cols_label(), gt_merge_stack_team_color() – format cells gt table logos, wordmarks, headshots, team-colored stacked text. Team utilities (R/cfb_team_tiers.R): cfb_team_tiers() (premade tier plot), cfb_team_factor() (factor-orders teams), plus add_athlete_id_col() (R/utils.R). Cleaning helpers (R/cleaning_helpers.R): clean_school_names(), clean_team_abbrs() – standardize user-supplied team name strings cfbplotR’s internal keys. Re-exports (R/reexports.R): set ggpath symbols (geom_from_path, GeomFromPath, element_path, element_raster, geom_mean_lines, geom_median_lines, GeomRefLines) re-exported users need attach ggpath directly. Team data: internal named lists logo_list wordmark_list (R/sysdata.rda) map school names image URLs. Exported data/ objects — logo_ref (school, color, alt_color, logo URLs; powers valid_team_names()), team_name_mapping, team_colors — documented R/data.R. regenerated via data-raw/build_logo_list.R / build_wordmark_list.R / build_team_colors.R.

Now quickly roll EPA data find EPA per rush EPA per pass every team week 1 take look plotting data.
code: #remotes::install_github(repo = "sportsdataverse/cfbfastR") #remotes::install_github(repo = "sportsdataverse/cfbplotR") #install.packages(tidyverse)  library(cfbfastR) library(cfbplotR) library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) library(ggplot2) library(tidyr) library(forcats) pbp <- cfbfastR::load_cfb_pbp(2021) %>%    filter(week == 1)  team_info <- cfbfastR::cfbd_team_info(year = 2021) team_info <- team_info %>%    dplyr::select("team" = "school", "conference", "mascot") %>%    dplyr::filter(conference %in% c("Pac-12","ACC","SEC","Big Ten","Big 12")) team_plot_data <- pbp %>%    dplyr::group_by(team = offense_play) %>%    dplyr::summarize(rush_epa = mean(if_else(rush == 1,EPA,NA_real_),na.rm = TRUE),             n_rush = sum(rush),             pass_epa = mean(if_else(pass == 1,EPA,NA_real_),na.rm = TRUE),             n_pass = sum(pass)) %>%    dplyr::filter(team %in% team_info$team) %>%    dplyr::left_join(team_info,by = "team")  head(team_plot_data) ## # A tibble: 6 × 7 ##   team          rush_epa n_rush pass_epa n_pass conference mascot       ##   <chr>            <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl> <chr>      <chr>        ## 1 Alabama         0.0502    105   0.0589    131 SEC        Crimson Tide ## 2 Arizona         0.178      31  -0.140      53 Pac-12     Wildcats     ## 3 Arizona State   0.256      65  -0.123      46 Pac-12     Sun Devils   ## 4 Arkansas        0.311      93  -0.543      48 SEC        Razorbacks   ## 5 Auburn          0.299      63   0.156      65 SEC        Tigers       ## 6 Baylor          0.185      86  -0.372      41 Big 12     Bears

title: cfbplotR 0.1.0
text: Rebuilt ggpath foundation (nflplotR/nbaplotR pattern). cfbplotR now resolves CFB identifier image path delegates rendering — caching, aspect ratio, alpha, colorization — ggpath. Dropped magick, RCurl, base64enc, purrr dependencies; added ggpath (>= 1.1.0). Raised requirements R (>= 4.1.0) ggplot2 (>= 4.0.0) (matching ggpath’s S7 theme elements). public API preserved: geom_from_path(), element_path(), ggpreview(), related generics remain available (geom_from_path() friends now re-exported ggpath). Breaking (minor): geom_mean_lines() / geom_median_lines() now re-exported ggpath use ggpath’s aesthetics x0 / y0 (vertical line x0, horizontal line y0) instead cfbplotR’s former v_var / h_var. Update calls accordingly, e.g. geom_median_lines(aes(x0 = pass_epa, y0 = rush_epa)). gt image helpers (gt_fmt_cfb_logo()/gt_fmt_cfb_headshot()/gt_fmt_cfb_wordmark()) now embed via gt::web_image(). New family-parity conveniences: gt_cfb_cols_label(), cfb_team_factor(), clean_team_abbrs(), .cfbplotR_clear_cache(). Added repository community-health files (CLAUDE.md, Copilot instructions, issue/PR templates, CONTRIBUTING, Code Conduct), normalized badges, standard SportsDataverse README, bibentry() citation, richer pkgdown reference. add_athlete_id_col() longer aborts cfbfastR-data published current season’s roster file yet. most_recent_cfb_season() rolls August 15, roster file lands season starts, every August default call died open connection. Unavailable seasons now named skipped, season-less request falls back previous season.
